newsitem.title: USA: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.
newsitem.headline: U.S. barley weekly export sales highlights--USDA.

text.p: USDA barley export sales highlights in latest reporting week:

Net sales reductions of 40,000 MT for unknown destinations (20,000 MT) and Japan (20,000 MT) were the result of sales being switched from the current marketing year to 1997/98. Sales of 255,000 MT for delivery in 1997/98 were for unknown destinations (235,000 MT) and Japan (20,000 MT).
Exports of 2,200 MT--all to Mexico--were 80 percent below the previous week and 71 percent under the 4-week average.
